author: Max Edmands
message:
Fascinating, and a great point. Seems like what you're describing is a version of the availability heuristic: "a mental shortcut that occurs when people make judgments about the probability of events by how easy it is to think of examples." http://en.wikipedia.org/wik...

Also, just want to point out that there are a lot of people out there who have positive connotations with the words anarchism, communism, or nihilism.

author: Dan Tao
message:
